name: TC-453: HQ's Finalise of the basket on a tenant with no saved card becomes 'Ready to print — needs your payment' + a 'Pay $… to print' link — never a silent charge
description: HQ finalises the basket as one set (POST /api/admin/supply-shop/finalise, what the Finalise dialog sends): $207.00 is within the $258.75 the owner agreed to, so it is collected, not sent for approval. IMMEDIATE with no card on file falls back to the charge's hosted Checkout: the price is final ($207.00, shown in place of the estimate), the line grows a Pay button and the basket a 'Finish payment' link, both pointing at Stripe, and the 'chargePaymentNeeded' email carries the same link. Completing Checkout is out of reach on QA (Radar hCaptcha).
